node.statement: Upper-norm clause. For every n>=1 and Z in M_n tensor S_P, lem-hcb3-diagonal-upper-norm and e<=e_H<=e_up give ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)||<=(1+C_up*e)||Z||<=(1+C_H*e)||Z||, which is the required uniform amplified upper-norm estimate.
